assumptions.condition: For every \(n\), \(O_{n1},\ldots,O_{nn}\) are independent draws from \(P_n\).
For every \(n\), \(P\mapsto\eta(P)\) is pathwise differentiable at \(P_n\) with mean-zero influence representative \(\psi_n\).

standard.name: Pathwise differentiability of a finite-dimensional parameter

assumptions.condition: For fixed \(c\in(0,1)\), \(cI_d\preceq V_n\preceq c^{-1}I_d\) for every \(n\).
For a chosen procedure, \(\sqrt n(\widehat\eta_n-\eta_n)=n^{-1/2}\sum_{i=1}^n\psi_n(O_{ni})+o_{P_n}(1)\) uniformly over its paired law sequences.
For a chosen procedure, \(n^{-1}\sum_{i=1}^n\|\widehat\psi_{ni}-\psi_n(O_{ni})\|^2=o_{P_n}(1)\) uniformly over its paired law sequences.
For a chosen procedure, \(\|\widehat V_n-V_n\|_{\mathrm{op}}=o_{P_n}(1)\) uniformly over its paired law sequences.

standard.name: Uniform covariance law of large numbers

definitions.name: Rank-stratified Moore--Penrose gain null
definitions.construction: Set \(\Delta(\eta)=a(\eta)^{\prime}K(\eta)\{K(\eta)^{\prime}K(\eta)\}^{\dagger}K(\eta)^{\prime}a(\eta)\), \(\mathcal N_{\delta,r}=\{\eta\in\mathcal E_C:\Delta(\eta)=\delta,\operatorname{rank}K(\eta)=r\}\), and \(\mathcal N_\delta=\bigcup_{r=0}^p\mathcal N_{\delta,r}\). Rank is encoded by vanishing \((r+1)\)-minors and a finite disjunction of nonzero \(r\)-minors. The exact union is used even when it is nonclosed; \(\inf\varnothing=+\infty\), and distance to an empty lower-rank union is \(+\infty\).

definitions.name: Terminating complete common-draw null-envelope algorithm
definitions.construction: Choose \(r_n\to\infty\), \(r_n/\sqrt n\to0\), \(\gamma_n\downarrow0\), \(\zeta_n\downarrow0\), and \(B_n\to\infty\) so the fixed-complexity VC bound and all rational-enclosure errors total \(\epsilon_n^{\mathrm{alg}}=o(\gamma_n)\). Given \((\delta,y,V)\), use rational outward enclosures of \(y,V,V^{1/2}G_b\), common draws \(G_b\sim\mathcal N(0,I_d)\), and cylindrical algebraic decomposition with quantifier elimination to decide every exact-rank stratum, compute the global infimum \(T_n\), and optimize over every point of \(\Gamma_n\). For every candidate, compute the empirical CDF, left CDF, atom mass, and randomized upper critical pair from the complete distance statistic. CAD partitions all order-statistic branches and returns the global supremum critical value, never a visited-point approximation. If a supremum is unattained, return its certified upper endpoint plus the outward error and equality probability zero. If it is attained, use the infimum certified equality probability among all maximizers; any unresolved equality enclosure uses zero. Use the \(1-\alpha+\gamma_n\) \(\chi_d^2\) quantile only when emptiness of the outward candidate set is certified. Strict rank inequalities are retained, so nonclosed nulls never acquire closure points. Reject above \(c_n^{\mathrm{alg}}\) and at equality when \(U\le\rho_n^{\mathrm{alg}}\), and invert the tests. This finite Boolean-semialgebraic algorithm terminates for every input.

definitions.name: Row-specific complete Gaussian benchmark
definitions.construction: Set \(Y_n^{\mathrm G}=\eta_n+n^{-1/2}Z_n\) with \(Z_n\sim\mathcal N(0,V_n)\), and rerun the identical \(\mathsf{ALG}_n\) code, rational-enclosure rule, common-draw array, empty-set branch, maximizer rule, and atom randomization at \((Y_n^{\mathrm G},V_n)\). The resulting rejection probability is \(\pi_n^{\mathrm G}(\delta;P_{\bullet})\).

definitions.name: Envelope-scale alternatives
definitions.construction: \[\mathcal P_{\mathrm{alt}}(\delta,C_A)=\{P_{\bullet}\in\mathcal P_{\mathrm{loc}}:\inf_{\eta\in\mathcal N_\delta}\|\eta_n-\eta\|_{V_n^{-1}}\le C_Ar_n/\sqrt n\text{ for every row }n\}.\]

definitions.name: Exact observed-data OVS finite-cell collision law
definitions.construction: Order the eight cells \(j=(2,0),(2,1),(3,0),(3,1),(4,0),(4,1),(\infty,0),(\infty,1)\). Let \(h_j=h_j^0+\rho_px_j\) for \(j\le7\), where \(h_j^0=1/(9-j)\), \(x_j\in[-1,1]\), and fixed \(\rho_p>0\) keeps every \(h_j\) in a compact subset of \((0,1)\). Set \(p_j=h_j\prod_{\ell<j}(1-h_\ell)\) and \(p_8=\prod_{\ell<8}(1-h_\ell)\). Conditional on \(J=(s,1)\), draw a Rademacher \(\zeta\). Set \(Y_1(\infty)=0\). For \(s=2\), set \(Y_2(\infty)=0\) and \(Y_3(\infty)=\sqrt{p_{(2,1)}}\zeta\); for \(s=3\), set \(Y_2(\infty)=0\) and \(Y_3(\infty)=\sqrt{p_{(3,1)}}\zeta\); for \(s=4\), set \(Y_3(\infty)=\sqrt{p_{(4,1)}}\zeta\) and \(Y_2(\infty)=-t\sqrt{p_{(4,1)}}\zeta\); and for \(s=\infty\), set \(Y_2(\infty)=0\) and \(Y_3(\infty)=\sqrt{p_{(\infty,1)}}\zeta\). Set \(Y_1(\infty)=Y_2(\infty)=Y_3(\infty)=0\) in every \(Q=0\) cell; in cell \((4,0)\), equivalently write its second increment as \((1-t)\sqrt{p_{(4,0)}}\zeta_{40}\) with \(\zeta_{40}\equiv0\). Set \(Y_4(\infty)\in\{-1,1\}\) in cell \((4,0)\) with conditional mean \(t\), independently of periods one through three, and set it to zero elsewhere. Define \(Y_3(2)=Y_3(\infty)+\beta_2\), \(Y_3(3)=Y_3(\infty)+\beta_3\), and all other adoption-date potential outcomes equal to their untreated values. Observe \(Y_u=Y_u(S)\) when \(Q=1\) and \(Y_u=Y_u(\infty)\) when \(Q=0\). Thus treatment is \(D_u=1\{Q=1,S\le u\}\), no anticipation holds, and the two untreated DDD trends have zero conditional means. Restrict \(x\), \(\beta\), and \(t\in[-c_t,c_t]\subset(-1/4,1/4)\) to a compact box. The class \(\mathcal P_{\mathrm D}^{\mathrm{coll}}\) contains every iid triangular array generated by this construction. Outcomes and all increments are uniformly bounded, every observed cell mass is bounded away from zero, and all OVS regressions and generalized propensities are saturated cell functionals.

definitions.name: Explicit minimal DDD estimator and multiplier
definitions.construction: Let \(\widehat p_j=n^{-1}\sum_i1\{J_i=j\}\), \(\widehat h_j=\widehat p_j/(1-\sum_{\ell<j}\widehat p_\ell)\), and \(\widehat x_j=(\widehat h_j-h_j^0)/\rho_p\). Estimate \(\beta_2\) and \(\beta_3\) by the saturated conditional means of \(Y_3-Y_1\) in cell \((2,1)\) and \(Y_3-Y_2\) in cell \((3,1)\), and estimate \(t\) by the saturated conditional mean of \(Y_4\) in cell \((4,0)\). Stack these ten coordinates as \(\widehat\eta_{\mathrm D,n}\), use their plug-in influence values and empirical covariance \(\widehat V_{\eta,\mathrm D,n}\), and form common Gaussian multipliers. Apply Definition \(\ref{def:complete-cad-envelope}\) to the semialgebraic map \(K(\eta)=F(t)N_{\mathrm D}\), \(a(\eta)=F(t)b_{\mathrm D}^{\mathrm{sep}}(t)\).

definitions.name: Optional Gaussian rank-collision decision problem
definitions.construction: Fix an interior primitive collision point \(\eta_0\), covariance \(V\), radius \(C_H\), tested value \(\delta\), and finite \(M>0\). Observe \(X=h+Z\), \(Z\sim\mathcal N(0,V)\), \(h\in\mathcal H_{\mathrm{coll}}\). Define \(\Delta_{\mathrm{coll}}(h)=\lim_{u\downarrow0}\Delta(\eta_0+uh)\), \(\mathcal H_{0,\delta}=\{h:\Delta_{\mathrm{coll}}(h)=\delta\}\), and its complement \(\mathcal H_{1,\delta}\). Competing tests are all measurable randomized \(\phi\) with \(\sup_{h\in\mathcal H_{0,\delta}}E_h\phi\le\alpha\); strict dominance means weakly higher power at every \(h\in\mathcal H_{1,\delta}\) and strict inequality somewhere. Competing confidence procedures have uniform coverage and loss \(L_M(C,\delta)=\min\{\operatorname{diam}(C),M\}+M1\{\delta\notin C\}\). Set \(R_M^\star=\inf_C\sup_{h\in\mathcal H_{\mathrm{coll}}}E_hL_M(C,\Delta_{\mathrm{coll}}(h))\). The handle is a finite rank-stratified semialgebraic saddle program over randomized acceptance regions.

statements.statement: For every positive-semidefinite \(\Omega=F^{\prime}F\), feasible loading \(b\), and quotient basis \(N\), the minimum over \(b+\operatorname{col}(N)\) is attained by \(b-N(FN)^{\dagger}Fb\), and the variance reduction is \[(Fb)^{\prime}(FN)\{(FN)^{\prime}(FN)\}^{\dagger}(FN)^{\prime}(Fb).\] This remains exact when \(\Omega\) is singular.
statements.justification: The identity connects the Moore--Penrose target to the actual joint-versus-separate score variance difference.
statements.gap: The positive-definite inverse identity is imported from the bank receipt; only its positive-semidefinite extension is supporting algebra.
statements.consumer: It certifies that the OVS application target is an actual variance gain rather than a surrogate projection.

statements.statement: Uniformly over \((P_{\bullet},\mathfrak A_{\bullet})\in\mathfrak A_{\mathrm{adm}}\), \(\sqrt n(\widehat\eta_n-\eta_n)\) is bounded-Lipschitz approximated by \(\mathcal N(0,V_n)\), \(\widehat V_n\) is uniformly consistent, and each common multiplier draw is conditionally exactly \(\mathcal N(0,\widehat V_n)\).
statements.justification: This standard triangular-array lemma supplies the Gaussian input without attributing it to generic local asymptotic normality.
statements.gap: It is a supporting Lindeberg--Feller and covariance argument, not a novelty claim.
statements.consumer: The complete envelope theorem uses its uniform coupling error.

statements.statement: At a rank-zero collision, let \(K_n=H/\sqrt n\), \(a_n=a_0+h/\sqrt n\), and suppose the primitive Gaussian limit induces blocks \((Z_K,Z_a)\). If \(H^{\prime}a_0\ne0\), then \(\Delta_n\to a_0^{\prime}H(H^{\prime}H)^{\dagger}H^{\prime}a_0>0\), while \[\Delta(\widehat K_n,\widehat a_n)\Rightarrow a_0^{\prime}(H+Z_K)\{(H+Z_K)^{\prime}(H+Z_K)\}^{\dagger}(H+Z_K)^{\prime}a_0.\] If \(H^{\prime}a_0=0\), then \(n\Delta_n\to h^{\prime}H(H^{\prime}H)^{\dagger}H^{\prime}h\), but the unscaled plug-in generally retains the same nondegenerate random-projection limit. Hence pointwise Moore--Penrose plug-in inference is not uniformly consistent at rank collision.
statements.justification: The random projection is the nonregular phenomenon the rank-free procedure must protect against.
statements.gap: Fang--Santos and Hong--Li require directional differentiability or continuity, while this gain map is discontinuous at rank loss.
statements.consumer: It explains the failure of the banked descriptive DDD gain plug-in near a shared-cell rank collision.

statements.statement: For fixed \(d,m,q\) and fixed semialgebraic complexity, \(\mathsf{ALG}_n\) terminates measurably and returns global rather than visited-candidate extrema on every rank stratum. The sublevel, strict-sublevel, and equality classes generated by \(T_n\) have a common finite VC dimension \(v_0\). If \((v_0\log B_n+\log(1/\zeta_n))/B_n=o(\gamma_n^2)\), then with probability at least \(1-\zeta_n\), uniformly over all candidates and thresholds, the empirical CDF and left CDF errors are at most \(\epsilon_n^{\mathrm{alg}}\), atom-mass error is at most \(2\epsilon_n^{\mathrm{alg}}\), and the generalized empirical quantile obeys \[q_{n,\eta}(u-\epsilon_n^{\mathrm{alg}})\le\widehat q_{n,\eta}(u)\le q_{n,\eta}(u+\epsilon_n^{\mathrm{alg}}).\] The statement covers atoms without a density assumption. The outward critical branch, zero randomization under unresolved equality or nonattainment, certified-empty branch, and strict-rank CAD formulas are conservative on every execution path.
statements.justification: A complete optimizer and simultaneous atom-aware simulation control are necessary for the envelope to define an implementable test.
statements.gap: Generic resampling theory does not provide a terminating global search over a nonclosed union of exact-rank gain nulls.
statements.consumer: It rules out hidden visited-point and quantile approximations in the feasible DDD confidence set.

statements.statement: For every \(\delta\ge0\), the test in Definition \(\ref{def:complete-cad-envelope}\) satisfies \[\limsup_{n\to\infty}\sup_{\substack{(P_{\bullet},\mathfrak A_{\bullet})\in\mathfrak A_{\mathrm{adm}}:\Delta_n=\delta}}P_n\{\varphi_n(\delta)=1\}\le\alpha,\qquad \liminf_{n\to\infty}\inf_{(P_{\bullet},\mathfrak A_{\bullet})\in\mathfrak A_{\mathrm{adm}}}P_n\{\Delta_n\in\mathcal C_{n,1-\alpha}^{\Delta}\}\ge1-\alpha.\] These bounds hold over every bounded null triangular array and every singular-value threshold crossing, without rank selection or spectral separation. Uniformly over admissible pairs with \(P_{\bullet}\in\mathcal P_{\mathrm{alt}}(\delta,C_A)\), \[\left|P_n\{\varphi_n(\delta)=1\}-\pi_n^{\mathrm G}(\delta;P_{\bullet})\right|\to0.\] The Gaussian benchmark reruns the identical complete algorithm and common-draw rule. Proof proceeds by uniform inclusion of the true null point, exact-rank semialgebraic subsequences, and the Andrews--Cheng--Guggenberger subsequence-to-uniformity argument.
statements.justification: This is the field-tier kernel: honest inference on a nonclosed exact gain null through all rank collisions.
statements.gap: Andrews--Guggenberger test moment restrictions under singular covariance; they do not test this exact Moore--Penrose gain null or construct its complete rank-stratified envelope.
statements.consumer: It upgrades the banked shared-cell DDD gain diagnostic from a pointwise number to a uniformly valid test and confidence set.

statements.statement: The Gaussian power approximation in Theorem \(\ref{thm:uniform-complete-envelope}\) holds uniformly when \(s_{jn}=t_jr_n/\sqrt n+o(r_n/\sqrt n)\), jointly over \(t\) in compact subsets of \([0,\infty)^p\). Calibration remains least favorable in this threshold band. If the eventual rank is \(r_0\) and \(\sqrt n/r_n\) times the distance to \(\bigcup_{r<r_0}\mathcal N_{\delta,r}\) diverges, the envelope recovers the known-rank stratum-oracle critical pair. When \(r_0=0\), the premise is automatic; every empty lower-rank union or stratum has distance \(+\infty\). No oracle-size claim is made inside the threshold band.
statements.justification: The result characterizes local power where a rank selector would be unstable and states the exact price of protection.
statements.gap: Existing weak-identification and singularity-robust tests do not provide this Moore--Penrose gain threshold-band power law.
statements.consumer: It gives the row-specific power curve for the actual OVS path \(t_n=c r_n/\sqrt n+o(r_n/\sqrt n)\).

statements.statement: In \(\mathcal P_{\mathrm D}^{\mathrm{coll}}\), equations (4.16)--(4.17) of Ortiz--Villavicencio and Sant'Anna give \(\psi_c^{g,3}=\psi_{g,0}^{g,3}+\psi_{c,1}^{g,3}-\psi_{c,0}^{g,3}\) and \(\psi_{s,q}^{g,3}=\psi_{s,q}^{g,3,1}-\psi_{s,q}^{g,3,0}-\psi_{s,q}^{g,3,\mathrm{est}}\). For saturated cell regressions, \(M^1=E(w_{\mathrm{trt}}-w_{s,q})=0\); for saturated cell propensities, every term in \(M^2\) is a normalized conditional residual mean and equals zero. Thus all nuisance-estimation terms vanish. The normalized cohort-four comparison residuals in the second block are exactly \((1+t_n)U_{4,ni}+(1-t_n)U_{40,ni}\), with \(U_{40,ni}=0\), and the four centered RIF coordinates derived from the OVS equations are \[R_{\mathrm D,ni}-B_{\mathrm D}\beta_{\mathrm D,n}=(U_2+U_4,\ U_2+U_\infty,\ U_3+(1+t_n)U_4,\ U_3+U_\infty)^{\prime}.\] The four displayed residuals are orthonormal, hence the covariance is \(\Omega_{\mathrm D,n}=F(t_n)^{\prime}F(t_n)\). The blockwise separate optimum is \(b_{\mathrm D,n}^{\mathrm{sep}}=(1,1,2/D_n,2(1+t_n)^2/D_n)^{\prime}\), \(D_n=t_n^2+2t_n+2\). Moreover \[F(t)N_{\mathrm D}=\begin{pmatrix}1&1+t\\-1&-1\\0&0\\0&0\end{pmatrix},\quad a(t)=\left(\frac{t^2+4t+4}{D_t},\frac{3t^2+6t+4}{D_t},2,2\right)^{\prime}.\] Therefore rank is one and \(\Delta_{\mathrm D}=0\) at \(t=0\), while rank is two and \[\Delta_{\mathrm D}(t)=\frac{2(5t^2+12t+8)}{t^2+2t+2}\longrightarrow8\] for \(t\ne0\) approaching zero. Finally, the empirical estimator in Definition \(\ref{def:ovs-primitive-estimator}\) has the exact expansion \(\sqrt n(\widehat\eta_{\mathrm D,n}-\eta_{\mathrm D,n})=n^{-1/2}\sum_i\psi_{\eta,ni}+o_{P_n}(1)\) uniformly. Its probability-coordinate influence block is the nonsingular inverse-stick-breaking Jacobian times the seven-cell multinomial influence vector; the remaining three influences are \(U_2\), \(U_3\), and \(1\{J=(4,0)\}(Y_4-t_n)/p_{(4,0),n}\). Cross blocks vanish and the last three variances are \(1,1,(1-t_n^2)/p_{(4,0),n}\). Hence \(cI_{10}\preceq V_{\eta,\mathrm D,n}\preceq CI_{10}\), empirical influence values are uniformly \(L_2\)-consistent, and \(\widehat V_{\eta,\mathrm D,n}\) is uniformly consistent.
statements.justification: This proposition derives, rather than stipulates, the actual OVS score stack, primitive chart, and discontinuous zero-gain collision.
statements.gap: The OVS paper gives each pairwise RIF and within-block optimal combination; it does not study joint aggregate loading or inference on its rank-colliding gain.
statements.consumer: It verifies every law and procedure input needed to apply the complete envelope to the banked shared-cell staggered-DDD workflow.

statements.statement: Set \(d=10\), \(\eta_n=\eta_{\mathrm D,n}\), \(K(\eta)=F(t)N_{\mathrm D}\), and \(a(\eta)=F(t)b_{\mathrm D}^{\mathrm{sep}}(t)\). The procedure in Definition \(\ref{def:ovs-primitive-estimator}\) belongs to \(\mathfrak A_{\mathrm{adm}}\) by Proposition \(\ref{prop:actual-ovs-chart-and-collision}\). Consequently the complete CAD envelope has uniform size at every exact value of \(\Delta_{\mathrm D,n}\), its inverted set has uniform coverage over \(\mathcal P_{\mathrm D}^{\mathrm{coll}}\), and its row-specific Gaussian power approximation holds uniformly on \(t_n=c r_n/\sqrt n+o(r_n/\sqrt n)\) for \(c\) in compact sets. The identical feasible and Gaussian algorithms are rerun in the ten-dimensional primitive chart, and rank is never selected.
statements.justification: This theorem supplies honest inference for the genuine OVS joint-versus-separate variance gain at its actual rank collision.
statements.gap: The banked diagnostic and OVS optimal-weight theorem are pointwise and descriptive for this cross-block gain; neither covers the discontinuous zero-gain boundary.
statements.consumer: An analyst using the two OVS target blocks and shared cohorts \(4\) and \(\infty\) obtains a valid significance test and confidence set for the value of joint covariance optimization.

statements.statement: In the Gaussian experiment of Definition \(\ref{def:collision-decision-problem}\), characterize all level-\(\alpha\) tests undominated under the stated pointwise power order and determine whether \(R_M^\star\) is attained by an honest randomized confidence procedure. The handle is the specified finite rank-stratified semialgebraic saddle program, with size constraints enforced at every intersecting rank-loss limit and the bounded loss dualized over probability measures on \(\mathcal H_{\mathrm{coll}}\).
statements.justification: Uniform validity does not determine admissibility or minimax width at a discontinuous collision.
statements.gap: Neither directional-delta resampling nor singularity-robust moment testing solves this bounded Gaussian decision problem.
statements.consumer: A solution would identify whether the least-favorable OVS gain confidence set can be shortened without sacrificing collision honesty.

sampling_model.design: A fixed-dimensional iid triangular array. The generic theorem observes a regular primitive parameter and a semialgebraic map to the retained-score quotient geometry. The application is a four-period staggered-DDD panel with cohorts \(2,3,4,\infty\) and eligibility \(Q\in\{0,1\}\).
sampling_model.units: All eight cohort-by-eligibility cells have positive mass from a seven-coordinate stick-breaking chart. Outcomes have finite conditional support and uniformly bounded increments.
sampling_model.treatment: Treatment follows \(D_u=1\{Q=1,S\le u\}\). The target blocks are \(ATT(2,3)\) and \(ATT(3,3)\); the causal aggregate is \(2ATT(2,3)+2ATT(3,3)\).
sampling_model.overlap: Every cell mass is uniformly bounded away from zero. No anticipation and the two target-specific PT--DDD restrictions follow from the constructed untreated conditional means.
sampling_model.nuisance_estimation: Outcome regressions and generalized propensities are saturated. Their OVS influence corrections vanish by normalized-weight balance and conditional residual centering. The primitive probability and conditional-mean estimator, covariance, multiplier, and global envelope algorithm are explicit.

estimand_functional: \(\Delta_{\mathrm D}(\eta)=a_{\mathrm D}(\eta)^{\prime}K_{\mathrm D}(\eta)\{K_{\mathrm D}(\eta)^{\prime}K_{\mathrm D}(\eta)\}^{\dagger}K_{\mathrm D}(\eta)^{\prime}a_{\mathrm D}(\eta)\)
target_estimand: \(\Delta_{\mathrm D,n}=(b_{\mathrm D,n}^{\mathrm{sep}})^{\prime}\Omega_{\mathrm D,n}b_{\mathrm D,n}^{\mathrm{sep}}-\inf_{b:B_{\mathrm D}^{\prime}b=\omega_{\mathrm D}}b^{\prime}\Omega_{\mathrm D,n}b\)

bibliography.citation: Marcelo Ortiz-Villavicencio and Pedro H. C. Sant'Anna. Better Understanding Triple Differences Estimators. arXiv:2505.09942, revised 2025. Equations (4.16)--(4.17) give the composite pairwise influence functions; Theorem 4.1 gives pointwise asymptotic normality and within-target covariance-optimal aggregation.

Zheng Fang and Andres Santos. Inference on Directionally Differentiable Functions. Review of Economic Studies, 86(1):377--412, 2019. DOI: 10.1093/restud/rdy049. Sections 2--3 treat known Hadamard directionally differentiable maps and derivative-aware resampling.

Han Hong and Jessie Li. The Numerical Delta Method. Journal of Econometrics, 206(2):379--394, 2018. DOI: 10.1016/j.jeconom.2018.06.007. The main results concern directionally differentiable maps, with uniform results for specified convex Lipschitz cases.

Donald W. K. Andrews, Xu Cheng, and Patrik Guggenberger. Generic Results for Establishing the Asymptotic Size of Confidence Sets and Tests. Journal of Econometrics, 218(2):496--531, 2020. DOI: 10.1016/j.jeconom.2020.04.027. Section 2 supplies drifting-subsequence criteria for uniform size.

Donald W. K. Andrews and Patrik Guggenberger. Identification- and Singularity-Robust Inference for Moment Condition Models. Quantitative Economics, 10(4):1703--1746, 2019. DOI: 10.3982/QE1219. Sections 4--6 construct SR-AR and SR-CQLR tests and establish uniform size under weak identification and singular moment covariance.

Keisuke Hirano and Jack R. Porter. Impossibility Results for Nondifferentiable Functionals. Econometrica, 80(4):1769--1790, 2012. DOI: 10.3982/ECTA8681. The paper rules out locally asymptotically unbiased and quantile-unbiased estimator sequences for nondifferentiable targets.
A. W. van der Vaart. Asymptotic Statistics. Cambridge University Press, 1998.

Victor Chernozhukov, Denis Chetverikov, Mert Demirer, Esther Duflo, Christian Hansen, Whitney Newey, and James Robins. Double/Debiased Machine Learning for Treatment and Structural Parameters. Econometrics Journal, 21(1):C1--C68, 2018.

comparator_promise_table.comparator_claim: Equations (4.16)--(4.17) give pairwise staggered-DDD influence functions and Theorem 4.1 gives pointwise normality and covariance-optimal aggregation within each target block.
The paper establishes derivative-aware resampling for known Hadamard directionally differentiable transformations.
The paper establishes numerical-delta inference for directionally differentiable maps and uniform validity for specified convex Lipschitz maps.
The paper supplies generic drifting-subsequence results for uniform asymptotic size and similarity.
Sections 4--6 construct SR-AR and SR-CQLR tests with uniform size under weak identification and singular moment covariance.
The paper proves impossibility of locally asymptotically unbiased or quantile-unbiased estimation for nondifferentiable functionals.

tldr: The kernel is rank-free inference for the discontinuous Moore--Penrose variance gain, implemented for an actual Ortiz--Villavicencio--Sant'Anna shared-cell DDD system. The observed four-period law has cohorts \(2,3,4,\infty\), two eligibility groups, saturated nuisances, and a ten-dimensional regular probability-and-conditional-mean chart. Direct derivation from OVS equations (4.16)--(4.17) yields the four RIF coordinates and the factor \(F(t)\); the actual separate comparator gives a gain equal to zero at \(t=0\) and tending to eight from every nonzero nearby \(t\). A terminating common-draw CAD envelope searches every exact-rank null stratum, controls CDFs, left CDFs, atoms, and quantiles uniformly, and delivers honest coverage and threshold-band power without selecting rank.

project_justification.gap: The banked DDD receipt supplies only a pointwise descriptive gain under a positive-definite inverse identity. OVS supplies pairwise RIFs and within-target optimal weights, not inference on the cross-target joint-versus-separate gain. Directional-delta methods do not cover a discontinuous pseudoinverse map, and singularity-robust moment tests do not test its nonclosed exact null.
project_justification.niche: A valid procedure must operate in a regular observable primitive chart, include every exact-rank null point, and remain implementable when the candidate set is nonclosed and the distance law has atoms.
project_justification.fill: The project derives the actual OVS collision from its published influence equations, proves primitive-chart regularity, characterizes the random projection limit, and constructs a globally terminating atom-aware Gaussian envelope with uniform size, coverage, and threshold-band power approximation.

related_work: Ortiz--Villavicencio and Sant'Anna (2025, equations (4.16)--(4.17) and Theorem 4.1) provide the pairwise staggered-DDD influence functions and within-target covariance-optimal aggregation used to derive the application. The banked \(\texttt{stat\_ddd\_overid\_efficiency/v1}\) receipt supplies the retained affine loading geometry; its algebra is imported, with only the positive-semidefinite extension proved here. Fang and Santos (2019, Sections 2--3) and Hong and Li (2018) inform derivative-aware resampling but require directional differentiability or continuity, which fails at the Moore--Penrose rank collision. Andrews and Guggenberger (2019, Sections 4--6) give uniform-size SR-AR and SR-CQLR tests for weak identification and singular moment covariance, not a test of the nonclosed exact gain null or its complete rank-stratified envelope. Andrews, Cheng, and Guggenberger (2020, Section 2) supply only the subsequence-to-uniformity framework. Hirano and Porter (2012) supply the nondifferentiability impossibility boundary: honest inversion can remain valid, but no regular or locally unbiased point-estimation claim is available. Van der Vaart (1998) and Chernozhukov et al. (2018) support the non-novel influence calculations. No general comparator is claimed to be dominated.
technical_internal_limitation: The finite common-draw CAD algorithm is a mathematical implementation certificate, not a claim of low computational cost. Exact rank strata may be nonclosed, so the algorithm uses certified suprema and conservative nonattainment branches. At the OVS collision, honest confidence sets can remain nonshrinking. The gain is discontinuous even though its ten-dimensional primitive chart is regular.
honest_scope: The contribution concerns inference on the joint-versus-separate retained-score variance gain, not inference on the causal aggregate itself. The DDD result is restricted to the displayed actual OVS finite-cell collision class. It makes no claim about arbitrary-pattern canonical gradients, full semiparametric efficiency, Bellégo nesting, or comparisons across missingness regimes. It makes no regular, locally unbiased, or uniformly consistent point-estimation claim for the gain at collision. Outside the constructed class, an application must verify a regular primitive chart and admissible procedure inputs.
message: Rebuilt the core around an exact OVS four-period observed-data law, derived its four RIF coordinates from equations (4.16)--(4.17), proved the regular minimal primitive chart and true zero-to-eight gain collision, and replaced visited-candidate simulation by a terminating global CAD/common-draw envelope with atom-aware uniform control.
